learned_selector: #product-list a.woocommerce-loop-product__link (fallback ul.products, then the observed WooCommerce loop link)
operation: Collect distinct resolved product-detail hrefs before saving; inspect up to six scroll results for more observed links; save at most input.max_items, excluding input.exclude_urls.
assumptions: The input listing exposes product links through the WooCommerce loop anchor.
limitations: If the listing uses another card structure or scroll reveals no matching links, fewer than the requested number are saved.
